The buildable AREA is now withheld with a stated reason rather than printed, which is a BETTER outcome than this row own close predicted (it predicted a corrected 16,767 sq ft figure): a declared refusal outranks a recomputed number on an atom that has not been re-baked.

leave_behind.item: The Cloud Run Deploy (cortex-api) workflow is named for something it does not do on push. Its green check reads as deployed and means image built, and that mis-reading cost one production outage and one wrong handoff. Rename it, or make the push job state build-only in its own summary.
